entities.name: James B. Adams
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: James Blackburn Adams was an American attorney, politician, and two-time associate director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. Earlier in his career, he had served in the Texas House of Representatives as a member of the Democratic Party.
